title: Guided v7.1 (consensus-anchored revision) confirmation on new 2026 literature
status: registered before any method arm was run on the confirmation papers
development: lit172g (165 papers) was used to diagnose v7, choose the support threshold (3/7, 2-fold CV) and run v7.1 once: v7.1 - Direct_clues recall +4.4 [1.0, 8.1]; v7.1 - SC15 +4.0 [1.6, 6.7]; precision -0.2. These papers are excluded from confirmation.

confirmation_set.batch1: the 58 lit150 PDFs not in the lit172 manifest (46 usable after argon gold)
confirmation_set.batch2: experiments/lit_more/fetch_more.py rule (2026-01-01..2026-11-05 OA mechanistic papers, >=3 mechanistic-experiment categories, rank order, TARGET 260 PDFs), appended as batch 2 unchanged
confirmation_set.gold: p29_gold_rebuild.py with gemini-4-argon-build reading the PDF; usable = reaction_ok and >=1 gold substrate intermediate and clues present; a paper whose extraction fails after the scripted retries (or returns malformed JSON twice) is excluded before any arm is scored

primary.metric: per-paper recall of gold substrate intermediates (sigma-graph keys, species de-duplicated)
primary.population: all usable papers of batch 1 + batch 2
primary.test: reaction-clustered paired bootstrap 95% CI (K.paired); PASS iff lower bound > 0

other_secondary: F1 and relaxed recall for all contrasts
interim: batch 1 (46 papers) is analyzed first and reported descriptively (--batch 1). It does not stop, extend or change the study; no code, prompt, threshold or rule may change after registration. The primary result is the analysis of batch 1 + batch 2.
deviations: any deviation is recorded here with date and reason; failed calls are retried from cache only

log.note: batch 2 gold: 259/260 extracted (1 paper PMC excluded: argon 413 payload too large after scripted retries; 122 first-pass 502s retried at concurrency 30 with unchanged code), 225 usable. Batch-1 arm run (not yet analyzed) merged into one run over batch 1 + batch 2 for efficiency; cached calls reused, no code change.

merged batch 1+2 run stopped in auto_pool (1350/1626 jobs failed): gateway 429, gemini-3.8-flash quota exhausted on all accounts (earliest reset 15:59). The per-batch analyses that ran after the failure used incomplete arms; they were moved unread to _invalid_incomplete_20261106/. Resuming the same frozen code and model from cache once quota returns; no code, prompt, model or threshold change.

Scope reduction decided before any confirmation outcome was computed or seen, following the paper plan (D3/D4: no version comparisons in the paper; SC@15 reported on the dev set): the confirmation runs only Direct, MechSight_Auto, Direct_clues and Guided_v71 via p31_confirm_core.py (sha256 22d5426149a5868046ac342071bc2ba81facbe4055a3a1473dc2846bd8d5bdc0), which selects phases of the unchanged p31_guided71.py. Dropped arms: Guided_v7, SC7, SC15 (with clue samples 3..14). The key secondary Guided_v71 - SC15 is withdrawn; the primary (Guided_v71 - Direct_clues recall, CI lower bound > 0) and precision non-inferiority (-3 pp) are unchanged.
